---
title: "2 Samuel"
---

# 2 Samuel

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

2 Samuel chronicles David's reign, revealing both his greatest triumphs and deepest failures. The book demonstrates God's covenant faithfulness despite human weakness and points toward the coming eternal King.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 1:26</div>

<div class="identifier">Wonderful was thy love to me</div>

### Why This Verse

David's lament for Jonathan

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records David's response to the deaths of Saul and Jonathan. The key verse highlights David's honor, grief, and respect for God's anointed.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 2:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Shall I go up?</div>

### Why This Verse

David seeks God's guidance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes David's rise as king of Judah. The key verse emphasizes seeking God's guidance before taking action.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 3:39</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD reward the evildoer</div>

### Why This Verse

David's response to Abner's death

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the struggle between the houses of Saul and David. The key verse highlights God's steady fulfillment of His promise to David.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 4:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Mephibosheth was lame</div>

### Why This Verse

Important introduction

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the murder of Ish-bosheth. The key verse demonstrates David's commitment to justice despite personal advantage.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 5:10</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD God of hosts was with him</div>

### Why This Verse

Summary of David's rise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter marks David's coronation over all Israel and the capture of Jerusalem. The key verse emphasizes that David's success came from God's presence.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 6:14</div>

<div class="identifier">David danced before the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous worship passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the return of the ark to Jerusalem. The key verse highlights joyful worship and reverence for God's holiness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 7:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Thy kingdom shall be established forever</div>

### Why This Verse

Davidic Covenant centerpiece

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records God's covenant with David. The key verse promises an enduring kingdom and points forward to the Messiah.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 8:15</div>

<div class="identifier">David executed justice and righteousness</div>

### Why This Verse

Summary of David's reign

### Chapter Insight

This chapter summarizes David's military victories and administration. The key verse emphasizes that the Lord gave David victory wherever he went.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 9:7</div>

<div class="identifier">I will show thee kindness</div>

### Why This Verse

David's grace to Mephibosheth

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records David's kindness to Mephibosheth. The key verse illustrates covenant faithfulness and undeserved grace.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 10:12</div>

<div class="identifier">Be of good courage</div>

### Why This Verse

Joab's exhortation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes David's war with Ammon and Syria. The key verse calls God's people to courage while trusting Him for the outcome.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 11:27</div>

<div class="identifier">The thing David had done displeased the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Judgment on David's sin

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts David's sin with Bathsheba. The key verse marks the beginning of a tragic season caused by moral failure.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 12:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou art the man</div>

### Why This Verse

Nathan confronts David

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Nathan's confrontation and David's repentance. The key verse reveals the seriousness of sin while pointing to God's mercy.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 13:22</div>

<div class="identifier">Absalom hated Amnon</div>

### Why This Verse

Beginning of family tragedy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Amnon's sin against Tamar and Absalom's revenge. The key verse demonstrates the devastating consequences of unchecked sin.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 14:14</div>

<div class="identifier">God devises means to bring back the banished</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently quoted mercy verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Absalom's return to Jerusalem. The key verse highlights the tension between justice and reconciliation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 15:26</div>

<div class="identifier">Let Him do to me as seems good</div>

### Why This Verse

David's submission

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Absalom's rebellion against David. The key verse reveals David's humility and trust in God's sovereignty.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 16:12</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD may look upon my affliction</div>

### Why This Verse

David's humility

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes David's flight and the responses of various individuals. The key verse demonstrates David's willingness to submit to God's discipline.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 17:14</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD had appointed to defeat Ahithophel's counsel</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine providence

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the competing counsel given to Absalom. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign overruling of human plans.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 18:33</div>

<div class="identifier">O my son Absalom</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the Bible's most famous laments

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Absalom's death and David's grief. The key verse reveals the heart of a father despite betrayal.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 19:14</div>

<div class="identifier">He bowed the hearts of Judah</div>

### Why This Verse

Restoration of David

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records David's restoration to the throne. The key verse highlights the challenge of reconciliation after conflict.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 20:22</div>

<div class="identifier">So he blew a trumpet</div>

### Why This Verse

End of Sheba's rebellion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Sheba's rebellion. The key verse emphasizes the ongoing need for unity under godly leadership.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 21:1</div>

<div class="identifier">There was a famine three years</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant accountability

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records acts of justice and victories over Israel's enemies. The key verse highlights covenant faithfulness and divine justice.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 22:31</div>

<div class="identifier">As for God, His way is perfect</div>

### Why This Verse

Classic statement of trust

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains David's song of deliverance. The key verse celebrates God as the source of strength, protection, and salvation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 23:3</div>

<div class="identifier">He that rules must be just</div>

### Why This Verse

David's last words

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records David's final words and honors his mighty men. The key verse reflects the ideal of righteous leadership under God's authority.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">2 Samuel 24:2</div>

<div class="identifier">Number the people</div>

### Why This Verse

Beginning of David's census account

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts David's census and its consequences. The key verse demonstrates David's trust in God's mercy even amid judgment.
:::
